title: Docs: README, CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md, pyproject
description: Rewrite the Resources table, note the renamed URI, record that resources/templates/completions/prompts sit outside the tool-surface budget and the resource error convention, and raise the mcp floor to >=2.2.0.

title: Two prompts whose args the chips fill
description: account_overview(profile, region) and investigate_resource(arn, profile), named with the tool prefix; argument names match the vocabulary variables.

title: tests: test_resources.py and test_completions.py
description: Offline tests for the gateway contract: the pairing rule asserted generically, enum-fragment body shape, the narrows cascade, zero AWS calls from listings, template variables matched against dump_tool_surface(), and not-found rather than empty.

title: completions.py: completion/complete handler
description: Complete view_id, profile, region and service for resource-template and prompt refs, narrowing on context.arguments, capped at 100 with total/has_more. No AWS calls.

title: vocabulary.py: the single source of chip values
description: New module producing (value,label) choices for profile, view_id, service and region, plus enum_body() - the one place the gateway's JSON Schema enum-fragment body shape is spelled.

title: Rewrite resources.py around the pairing rule
description: Nine URIs: four listings, five templates, aws://query/{profile}/{region}/{view_id} replacing the old wildcard template. Handlers raise ResourceNotFoundError/ResourceError instead of McpAwsError, which the SDK scrubs.

title: aws/regions.py: offline region knowledge
description: New pure module: list_regions(partition), partition_for(region), region_detail(region). Sourced from botocore bundled endpoint data and ~/.aws/config only - no network, no credentials.

title: cached_identity accessor on aws/profiles.py
description: Add a read-only cached_identity(profile) accessor so vocabulary labels can use an already-resolved identity without ever calling AWS.

title: Publish gateway vocabularies, completions and prompts
description: Extend mcp-aws with the optional things python-mcp-gateway's SERVER_AUTHORS.md says a server can publish: injectable-value vocabularies (listing/template pairs), completion/complete, and prompts whose args the same value chips fill. No new tools; the five-tool invariant and the test_surface.py budget are untouched.
acceptance_criteria: uv run pytest passes offline; test_surface.py unchanged and green; every published template pairs with a listing per the gateway rule; listings make zero AWS calls.
